cards.card_text: They were also alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise.
cards.verse_text: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
